title: Implement vector search with pgvector
summary: Implement HNSW vector search using pgvector for the retrieval pipeline.
description: We need to set up pgvector with HNSW indexes for approximate nearest neighbour search. The implementation must support filtered scans with exact-scan fallback for underfilled results.

comments.author: alice
comments.body: I'll start with the HNSW index configuration.

comments.author: bob
comments.body: Make sure to test the filtered underfill scenario.
